The Awtsmoos divides beauty into small responsibilities; Awtsmoos.com keeps glass, motion, onboarding, and provider setup separate so polish cannot become another tangled room.
-->

# Premium Polish File Plan

## New modules

- `scripts/config/minimaxLinks.js` — official MiniMax account/docs/billing URLs.
- `scripts/ui/CreateQuickGuide.js` — three-step workflow and prompt formula.
- `styles/glass.css` — translucent surfaces, borders, depth, ambient background.
- `styles/motion.css` — motion, shimmer, hover/press interaction, reduced-motion override.
- `styles/onboarding.css` — setup steps, external-link buttons, quick guide layout.

## Full-file rewrites

- `CreatePromptView.js` — insert quick guide while preserving templates/paste.
- `CreateConnectionView.js` — missing-provider CTA to official API Keys and Settings.
- `SettingsSections.js` — complete API setup instructions and official links.
- `index.html` — link glass/motion/onboarding styles.
- `browser-smoke.cjs` — verify links/instructions and that visual effects do not reintroduce overflow/overlap.

## Constraints

- Every file <=120 lines.
- Tabs for indentation.
- Full-file writes only.
- No browser field for an API key.
- Existing provider guard, templates, reference guidance, and mobile geometry remain intact.
